triggers.description: Bare Actuating implements, hands publication to Ship, and drives exhaustive review to closure.
Explicit routes select implement, triage, remediation-plan, or review-closeout.
Unqualified review, inspect, audit, or classify intent is non-mutating triage.

routes.description: Select and completely realize the current Construction.
Acquire review and classify Counterexamples without mutation.
Accumulate Counterexample knowledge, normalize the Construction, publish, and obtain exhaustive convergence.
Hand a current ready-to-ship proof to Ship.
Apply the closure theorem to current artifacts and observations.

success_signals: exactly four authoritative artifact families
Construction v5 is a proof-carrying predecessor-successor realization relation
review findings never select corrections or grant mutation
Actuating alone selects the Construction operation next action review credit and closure
Ledger remains structurally passive and Ship owns every public effect
failure_signals: a fifth authority artifact review-path artifact event kind or mutable workflow state is introduced
a repair mode change-kind semantic-model disposition or supersession disposition becomes authoritative
Ledger reviewer or supporting skill selects architecture mutation or closure
a public effect bypasses Ship
v1-v4 bytes are reinterpreted as v5
clauses.rationale: Authority remains small while the Construction carries the complete semantic and realization relation.

success_signals: every typed semantic element has exactly one predecessor carrier claim
every typed semantic element has exactly one selected successor factor binding
every selected factor carries at least one semantic element
closed-existing claims have exact-subject presence and closure receipts
open-existing and absent claims name concrete factor deltas
unresolved claims cannot authorize edit
failure_signals: a semantic claim is grounded only by prose or a path
a receipt is bound to another Goal Construction subject claim or obligation
absence is inferred from failure to find evidence
a mega-factor cannot identify one coherent owner-controlled construction surface
predecessor evidence is treated as successor closure evidence
clauses.rationale: Correct-by-construction requires a total interpretation from semantic declarations to evidenced code carriers.

success_signals: the Construction describes and proves differences without classifying them
introduced factors carry current laws realization and proof
retired factors carry current absence evidence
preserved factors are exact-equal
representation ownership boundary and admitted-domain changes manifest as factor deltas
a complete implementation rewrite may preserve the complete semantic relation
failure_signals: mode change_kind repair_class semantic_model_disposition or supersession_disposition is introduced
a free candidate transformation axis substitutes for concrete before-and-after objects
an unchanged abstract model conceals a representation or ownership replacement
diff size or source rewrite is mistaken for semantic novelty
clauses.rationale: A multidimensional successor relation cannot be faithfully or compositionally reduced to one repair label.

success_signals: every applicable accepted stable class appears in the cumulative Counterexample Theory
the class set is totally partitioned into generator and proof-carrying instance-specific classes
every generator names one typed required element and its exact carrier claim
duplicate witnesses campaign boundaries reviewer identity and finding order do not alter semantics
a recurring generator requires a concrete structural factor delta or valid separation
failure_signals: Construction selection uses only the latest review wave
a class remains both generator-bound and instance-specific
recurrence receives only another local test or guard
a separation proof does not remove the class from the shared generator
clauses.rationale: Knowledge accumulates monotonically and is quotiented before it becomes implementation structure.

success_signals: First Principles freezes an incumbent-independent basis before Universalist nomination
candidates carry concrete boundaries architectures semantic models and factors
every candidate carries the complete mandatory obligation core
at least one candidate is incumbent-independent
Metanoetic runs once only on a live unchanged decision surface
Reduce challenges disputable factors without selecting
reordering the same theory yields an equivalent selected Construction or the same incomparable minima
failure_signals: candidate transformation labels substitute for concrete candidates
a candidate wins by omitting an orthogonal obligation
implementation momentum or familiarity establishes dominance
Universalist Metanoetic or Reduce takes Actuating selection authority
clauses.rationale: Actuating normalizes complete knowledge instead of greedily folding patches.

success_signals: bounded operations isolate effects while one Construction remains the semantic epoch
closure-grade review begins only after complete realization
every semantic element maps to one current factor and bounded construction surface
every closed owner has a current bypass-absence receipt
every proof mechanism maps to one proof obligation
every retirement is proved on the exact current subject
failure_signals: fresh review starts on a half-realized Construction
predecessor receipts are reused as current-subject proof
an unmapped branch validator cache recovery path helper fixture or proof path remains live
a retirement is conceptual only
clauses.rationale: Two-sided evidence prevents a lawful plan from masquerading as a realized successor.

required_artifacts: five request bindings before initial dispatch
success_signals: initial standard plus four auxiliary requests launch concurrently
siblings are non-cancelling
verdictless recovery is request-local and occurs at most once
initial-wave standard clean counts as attempt one
four later standard attempts run serially
five consecutive distinct standard cleans close the exact unchanged subject
material mutation resets all review credit
accepted classes join the cumulative theory before mutation
failure_signals: the clean streak is weakened or replaced
a finding maps directly to a patch
review credit crosses a material subject change
invalid review provenance permanently enlarges implementation
clauses.rationale: Repeated nondeterministic review remains a direct stochastic falsification capability.

required_artifacts: current-subject realization closure and retirement receipts
success_signals: closure uses only current authority subject proof publication and review evidence
total realization correspondence and every retirement pass
Ship remains the sole public-effect owner
Actuating authors the semantic closure receipt
five current-subject standard cleans remain mandatory for final closeout
failure_signals: closure accepts an omitted accepted class or semantic element
closure accepts an unresolved claim unclosed bypass or stale receipt
closure accepts unmapped surface incomplete retirement or stale review credit
Ledger emits or authors the semantic verdict
clauses.rationale: Closure proves the current realized relation, not a label or the history that produced it.

instrumentation.rationale: Construction Contracts and Evidence events already carry Actuating decision evidence; a separate decision receipt would duplicate authority.
